# Agent brewing notes

## Espresso

An espresso shot pulled at nine bar with a finer grind extracts more sweetness; the agent suggests dialing the grind in small steps.

## Water

Filter coffee brewed with water just off the boil, around ninety three degrees, keeps the roast character.

## Cleaning

Descale the machine every month and backflush the group head after the last espresso of the day.
